title: MIDI: Update MIDI SysEx manufacturer ID database.
description:
Update the MIDI manufacturer IDs from the midi.org database.  The database URL
has changed, so update that too.

Some names contain interesting spellings which could potentially be typos but
could also be languages other than English or intentional spelling variations;
Those have been left as-is, same as we do in our other manufacturer name
databases.

----

I'll see about getting the script I used into a suitable condition to add to the
repo, but I'll do that separately from this database update.

commits_data.title: MIDI: Update MIDI SysEx manufacturer ID database.
commits_data.message:
MIDI: Update MIDI SysEx manufacturer ID database.

Update the MIDI manufacturer IDs from the midi.org database.  The database URL
has changed, so update that too.

Some names contain interesting spellings which could potentially be typos but
could also be languages other than English or intentional spelling variations;
Those have been left as-is, same as we do in our other manufacturer name
databases.
